subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should the active config file path be permanently displayed in the Control UI Overview snapshot card rather than Settings or a diagnostics surface?
rationale: The code path is sound, but the linked feature request offered multiple placements and the discussion contains no human maintainer selection of the permanent UI location.

options.title: Keep Overview placement
options.body: Approve the current compact callout and land it after live proof on the final rebased head.

options.title: Move to another surface
options.body: Request Settings or diagnostics placement before merge so filesystem details are grouped elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep Overview placement
